title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

exact_text.read_as: Fern House — correct in all three variants.
Weekend Plant Sale — correct in all three variants, with line breaks in the square and portrait.
20% off all indoor plants — correct in the square and portrait, but missing from the landscape.
Saturday & Sunday — correct in all three variants; the landscape also contains a second, garbled version.
Visit 24 Willow Lane — correct in all three variants, with a line break after Visit in the landscape.

faults.what: The landscape variant omits the required offer, “20% off all indoor plants”.
The landscape contains an extra, visibly garbled duplicate of “Saturday & Sunday” beneath the correctly rendered date line.

judge.summary: The three coordinated leafy ads use the requested formats and readable addresses, but the landscape needs correction because it omits the discount and adds a garbled duplicate date.

must_haves.item: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: The square, tall portrait, and wide landscape images have the requested proportions.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
must_haves.why: The discount string is absent from the landscape.

must_haves.item: Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
must_haves.why: The intended text and addresses are comfortably readable, but the landscape's additional date-like line is garbled and not cleanly readable.

must_haves.item: Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
must_haves.why: Dark green lettering sits on light backgrounds, with foliage kept clear of the text.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
must_haves.why: Text has adequate margins and is not clipped, but the extra landscape date line has visibly malformed lettering.

must_haves.item: The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.
must_haves.why: All three share leafy plants, green type, and light cream backgrounds, with stacked portrait text and a split text-and-plants landscape layout.
